run_m3gnet_relaxation: run M3GNet relaxation on a CIF structure string to get relaxed energy per atom and final structure
run_label_energies: run M3GNet relaxation on all CIF structures in a CSV file and save energies to a new CSV
run_e_above_hull: run energy above hull calculation for relaxed structures against the Materials Project phase diagram
generate_computed_structure_entry: generate a Materials Project ComputedStructureEntry from a pymatgen structure and M3GNet energy with MP2020 corrections
run_cli_e_above_hull: run the CLI tool to relax structures with M3GNet and calculate energy above hull from MP phase diagram
